metadata.name: lite_psm
metadata.description: LitePSM - USDC to OkuMoney peg stability module

instructions.name: accept_role_admin
docs: Step 2 of the two-step `RoleAdmin` rotation. Must be signed by the
`pending_role_admin` previously proposed via `set_authority(RoleAdmin,
new_admin)`. See `instructions::psm_admin::accept_role_admin`.

accounts.name: new_role_admin
docs: The proposed new role admin — must match `config.pending_role_admin`.

instructions.name: burn_oku_m_direct
docs: Burn OkuM directly without USDC payout (permissioned --
`direct_burner` only). Matches EVM `OkuM.burn(amount)` called
by a non-PSM `OKUM_BURNER`. Enables SVM->EVM bridging.

accounts.name: direct_burner
docs: Operator / bridge backend holding the `direct_burner` authority.

accounts.name: oku_m_mint
docs: OkuM mint (Token-2022). `mint::authority = config` is
defense-in-depth (see rationale on `MintOkuM::oku_m_mint`).

accounts.name: burner_oku_m_ata
docs: Burner's OkuM token account -- source of the burn. The burner
must hold the tokens it wants to destroy.

instructions.name: cancel_role_admin_transfer
docs: Withdraw an in-flight `RoleAdmin` two-step proposal (current
`role_admin` only). Useful for typo recovery before the new admin
accepts.

accounts.name: role_admin
docs: Role admin - only role_admin can update authorities

accounts.name: config
docs: PSM config

accounts.name: buffer_depositor_usdc_ata
docs: Buffer depositor's USDC account

accounts.name: vault_usdc
docs: PSM's USDC vault

accounts.name: freezer
docs: Blacklister authority - can freeze even when PSM is paused

accounts.name: oku_m_mint
docs: OkuM mint (Token-2022)

accounts.name: target_oku_m_ata
docs: Target account to freeze

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: USDC mint (standard SPL).
Must have exactly `TOKEN_DECIMALS` (= 6) decimals on Solana —
this matches the `OkuM` decimal model. EVM resolves
a runtime `usdcDecimalMultiplier` from `IERC20Metadata.decimals()`;
SVM hardcodes the value via the shared constant and asserts at
init.

accounts.name: oku_m_mint
docs: Fresh keypair for the OkuM mint (Token-2022).
The instruction creates this mint via manual CPIs with
ScaledUiAmount + MetadataPointer + TokenMetadata extensions.
The PsmConfig PDA is set as mint authority, freeze authority,
and ScaledUiAmount authority. Passed as a `Signer` because
`CreateAccount` requires the new account to sign.

accounts.name: vault_usdc
docs: PSM's USDC vault

instructions.name: mint_oku_m
docs: Mint OkuM with USDC (multiplier-aware)
raw_oku_m_amount = usdc_amount * PRECISION / multiplier

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: USDC mint

accounts.name: oku_m_mint
docs: OkuM mint (Token-2022 with ScaledUiAmount extension).
`mint::authority = config` is defense-in-depth: even if someone attempted
an out-of-band mint-authority rotation (which requires a CPI signed by
the current authority = config PDA, so it cannot happen without the
program's consent), this constraint would catch it at deserialization.

accounts.name: user_usdc_ata
docs: User's USDC account

accounts.name: user_oku_m_ata
docs: User's OkuM account

accounts.name: vault_usdc
docs: PSM's USDC vault

instructions.name: mint_oku_m_direct
docs: Mint OkuM directly without USDC (permissioned -- `direct_minter` only).
Matches EVM `OkuM.mint(to, amount)` called by a non-PSM `OKUM_MINTER`.

accounts.name: direct_minter
docs: Operator / fiat gateway holding the `direct_minter` authority.
Also pays for any ATA initialisation.

accounts.name: oku_m_mint
docs: OkuM mint (Token-2022). `mint::authority = config` is
defense-in-depth (see rationale on `MintOkuM::oku_m_mint`).

accounts.name: recipient
docs: Recipient of the minted OkuM. Does NOT need to sign --
the operator mints on behalf of the user.

accounts.name: recipient_oku_m_ata
docs: Recipient's OkuM token account. `init_if_needed` so the
recipient doesn't need a pre-existing ATA.

instructions.name: redeem_oku_m
docs: Redeem OkuM for USDC (multiplier-aware, with slippage protection)
usdc_amount = raw_oku_m_amount * multiplier / PRECISION
Pass min_usdc_out = 0 to skip slippage check.

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: USDC mint

accounts.name: oku_m_mint
docs: OkuM mint (Token-2022 with ScaledUiAmount extension).
`mint::authority = config` is defense-in-depth
(see rationale on `MintOkuM::oku_m_mint`).

accounts.name: user_usdc_ata
docs: User's USDC account

accounts.name: user_oku_m_ata
docs: User's OkuM account

accounts.name: vault_usdc
docs: PSM's USDC vault

accounts.name: role_admin
docs: Role admin - only role_admin can update authorities

accounts.name: config
docs: PSM config

accounts.name: oku_m_mint
docs: OkuM mint -- read so `set_max_supply` can refuse a new cap below
the current circulating supply (would silently brick all future
mints). EVM `OkuM.setMaxSupply` parity.

instructions.name: set_next_okum_yield_rate
docs: Pre-stage the successor rate that takes over at `okum_rate_end` with NO
transaction at the boundary (REBASER only).
EVM: `OkuMoney.setNextOkuMYieldRate(uint256,uint256)`.

accounts.name: rebaser
docs: Rebaser role — the single authority over yield on both stacks.
EVM mirror: `Roles.OKUM_REBASER`.

instructions.name: set_okum_multiplier
docs: EMERGENCY: force the multiplier to an explicit value and halt accrual
(REBASER only). The only instruction that engages the sandwich lock.
EVM: `OkuMoney.setOkuMMultiplier(uint256)`.

instructions.name: set_okum_yield_rate
docs: Set the active per-second rate and its bounded window (REBASER only).
EVM: `OkuMoney.setOkuMYieldRate(uint256,uint256)`.

accounts.name: rebaser
docs: Rebaser role — the single authority over yield on both stacks.
EVM mirror: `Roles.OKUM_REBASER`.

instructions.name: set_okum_yield_rate_with_successor
docs: Set the active rate and its successor atomically (REBASER only).
This is the instruction the epoch orchestrator uses.
EVM: `OkuMoney.setOkuMYieldRateWithSuccessor(uint256,uint256,uint256,uint256)`.

accounts.name: rebaser
docs: Rebaser role — the single authority over yield on both stacks.
EVM mirror: `Roles.OKUM_REBASER`.

instructions.name: sync_display_multiplier
docs: Refresh the wallet-facing ScaledUiAmount display mirror.
**Permissionless** — the written value is fully determined by on-chain
state, so the caller has no discretion. No EVM counterpart.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Anyone. Pays the transaction fee; gains nothing else.

accounts.name: oku_m_mint
docs: Mutable: the `UpdateMultiplier` CPI writes the extension.

accounts.name: unfreezer
docs: Unblacklister authority - can thaw even when PSM is paused (requires deliberate review)

accounts.name: oku_m_mint
docs: OkuM mint (Token-2022)

accounts.name: target_oku_m_ata
docs: Target account to thaw

instructions.name: update_token_metadata
docs: Set the OkuM mint's Token-2022 `TokenMetadata` `name`/`symbol` in
place (`role_admin` only) to the canonical OkuM ("OkuMoney") identity.
This is the true on-chain token identity shown by wallets and
explorers; the "$1-pegged usdOku" figure is a separate ScaledUiAmount
display value and is unaffected.

accounts.name: role_admin
docs: Role admin — only `role_admin` may rename the token.

accounts.name: config
docs: PSM config PDA. Holds the Token-2022 metadata `update_authority`
for the mint and CPI-signs the `update_field` calls.

accounts.name: oku_m_mint
docs: OkuM mint (Token-2022). The metadata is stored on the mint itself
(metadata-pointer points to self), so this is the `mut` metadata
account passed to `update_field`.

accounts.name: withdrawer_usdc_ata
docs: Buffer withdrawer's USDC account (destination)

accounts.name: vault_usdc
docs: PSM's USDC vault (source)

types.name: AuthorityRole
docs: Authority roles that can be updated via set_authority.
These roles govern PSM-specific operations.

types.name: AuthorityUpdatedEvent
docs: Emitted when a PSM authority role is updated.
For `RoleAdmin` rotations this fires twice: once at proposal time
(`new_authority` = the *pending* admin, surfaced via
`RoleAdminTransferProposed` for indexers that want to distinguish the
two phases) and a second time on acceptance (`old_authority` = previous
admin, `new_authority` = newly accepted admin).

types.name: BufferDepositEvent
docs: Emitted when USDC is deposited into buffer.
EVM equivalent: `BufferDeposited(address indexed depositor, uint256 amount, uint256 newBufferBalance)`

fields.name: orchestrator
docs: Depositor (orchestrator)

fields.name: amount
docs: Amount deposited (6 decimals)

fields.name: new_buffer_balance
docs: New buffer balance after deposit

types.name: BufferWithdrawEvent
docs: Emitted when USDC is withdrawn from buffer.
EVM equivalent: `BufferWithdrawn(address indexed to, uint256 amount, uint256 newBufferBalance)`

fields.name: actor
docs: Withdrawer (buffer_withdrawer role)

fields.name: amount
docs: Amount withdrawn (6 decimals)

fields.name: new_buffer_balance
docs: New buffer balance after withdrawal

types.name: DirectBurnEvent
docs: Emitted when OkuM is burned via the permissioned direct-burn path
(no USDC payout). EVM equivalent: the Transfer-to-zero event from
`OkuM.burn(amount)` called by a non-PSM burner.

fields.name: direct_burner
docs: Operator who initiated the burn

fields.name: raw_oku_m_amount
docs: OkuM raw amount burned (6 decimals)

fields.name: multiplier
docs: Canonical OkuM multiplier at time of burn, WAD-scaled (1e18 = $1.00).

fields.name: dollar_value
docs: Dollar value of the burned amount

fields.name: new_total_supply
docs: OkuM supply AFTER the burn completed

types.name: DirectBurnerAllowanceUpdatedEvent
docs: Emitted when direct-burner allowance is updated.
EVM equivalent: allowance management for the burner address.

fields.name: actor
docs: Caller of the update (`allowance_manager` authority).

types.name: DirectMintEvent
docs: Emitted when OkuM is minted via the permissioned direct-mint path
(no USDC required). EVM equivalent: the Transfer event from
`OkuM.mint(to, amount)` called by a non-PSM minter.

fields.name: direct_minter
docs: Operator who initiated the mint

fields.name: recipient
docs: Recipient of the minted OkuM

fields.name: raw_oku_m_amount
docs: OkuM raw amount minted (6 decimals)

fields.name: multiplier
docs: Canonical OkuM multiplier at time of mint, WAD-scaled (1e18 = $1.00).

fields.name: dollar_value
docs: Dollar value of the minted amount

fields.name: new_total_supply
docs: OkuM supply AFTER the mint completed

types.name: DirectMinterAllowanceUpdatedEvent
docs: Emitted when direct-minter allowance is updated.
EVM equivalent: `MinterAllowanceUpdated` (for the direct-minter address)

fields.name: actor
docs: Caller of the update (`allowance_manager` authority).

types.name: DisplayMultiplierSynced
docs: Emitted when the wallet-facing display mirror is refreshed.
Purely informational — no economic meaning. Useful for monitoring how far
the display has drifted from canonical and whether the crank is alive.

fields.name: multiplier
docs: Canonical multiplier written as immediately effective.

fields.name: pre_armed_multiplier
docs: Pre-armed next step.

fields.name: pre_armed_effective_ts
docs: When the pre-armed step becomes effective.

types.name: FreezeEvent
docs: Emitted when an account is frozen.
EVM equivalent: `Blacklisted(address indexed account)`

types.name: InitializeEvent
docs: Emitted when PSM is initialized.
EVM equivalent: the `Initialized(uint64 version)` event from OZ's `Initializable`
(LitePSM is upgradeable; there is no Solidity constructor event).

types.name: InitializeParams
docs: Parameter bundle for [`initialize`]. Bundling the initialization
arguments into a single named struct keeps the IDL self-documenting
and the call site hard to scramble (every field is named, not
positional).
The pubkey fields are the granular on-chain authorities; see
`roles::AuthorityRole` for the role catalogue and `SVM/README.md`
§ "Authority model" for the warm-vs-cold matrix.

types.name: MaxSupplyUpdatedEvent
docs: Emitted when max supply is updated.
EVM equivalent: `MaxSupplyUpdated(uint256 oldMaxSupply, uint256 newMaxSupply)`

fields.name: actor
docs: Caller of the update (`cap_manager` authority).

types.name: MintEvent
docs: Emitted when OkuM is minted via PSM.
EVM equivalent: `MintNote(address indexed user, uint256 usdcAmount, uint256 rawOkuMAmount, uint256 multiplier)`

fields.name: user
docs: User who minted

fields.name: usdc_amount
docs: USDC deposited (6 decimals)

fields.name: raw_oku_m_amount
docs: OkuM raw amount minted (6 decimals)

fields.name: dollar_value
docs: Dollar value of the minted amount (raw_oku_m_amount * multiplier / PRECISION)

fields.name: multiplier
docs: Canonical OkuM multiplier at time of mint, WAD-scaled (1e18 = $1.00).
Computed from the rate schedule, NOT read from the display mirror.
EVM equivalent: multiplier

fields.name: new_total_supply
docs: OkuM supply after the mint completed.

types.name: MinterAllowanceUpdatedEvent
docs: Emitted when minter allowance is updated.
EVM equivalent: `MinterAllowanceUpdated(address indexed minter, uint256 oldAllowance, uint256 newAllowance)`

fields.name: actor
docs: Caller of the update (`allowance_manager` authority).

types.name: MultiplierUpdated
docs: Emitted by the EMERGENCY multiplier override only.
Under streaming accrual this is a rare, incident-response event — not the
routine yield mechanism it used to be. Its presence in the log means an
operator forced a discrete jump and halted the schedule.
EVM equivalent: `MultiplierUpdated(uint256 oldMultiplier, uint256 newMultiplier, uint256 totalSupply)`

fields.name: old_multiplier
docs: WAD-scaled (1e18). Widened from `u64` with the PRECISION migration.

fields.name: total_supply
docs: Total OkuM supply at time of update

types.name: PauseEvent
docs: Emitted when PSM is paused.
EVM equivalent: `Paused(address account)`

types.name: PendingRateCancelled
docs: Emitted when an armed successor is discarded or replaced before it ever
activated.
Without this, a chain that had a successor staged and then had it silently
dropped would be indistinguishable — from the event log alone — from a chain
that still has one armed. Since the handover itself emits nothing (it needs
no transaction), the arm/cancel pair is the whole audit trail.
EVM equivalent: `PendingRateCancelled`.

types.name: PendingYieldRateUpdated
docs: Emitted when the PRE-STAGED successor rate changes.
The successor activates at `rate_end` with no transaction, so this event is
the only on-chain record of the handover being armed. Cross-chain
monitoring compares these across deployments.
EVM equivalent: `NextOkuMYieldRateSet(newRate, rateEnd, pendingEndTimestamp)`.

fields.name: rate_end
docs: The ACTIVE window's expiry — i.e. exactly when this successor takes
over. Carried because the handover needs no transaction, so this event
is the only on-chain record of when it will happen; cross-chain
monitoring compares this field across deployments.

fields.name: pending_rate_end
docs: Absolute expiry of the successor itself, bounding the overhang.

types.name: PsmConfig
docs: PSM configuration PDA.
Seeds: `["psm_config"]`. This is the single, program-wide config
account; it holds the granular authorities, token references, limits,
and the yield-distribution slot.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump seed

fields.name: role_admin
docs: Meta role: grant/revoke roles (cold multisig)

fields.name: pauser
docs: Warm Multisig - pause only

fields.name: unpauser
docs: Cold Multisig - unpause only

fields.name: freezer
docs: Warm Multisig - freeze accounts

fields.name: unfreezer
docs: Cold Multisig - thaw accounts (requires deliberate review)

fields.name: buffer_depositor
docs: Orchestrator - deposit USDC buffer

fields.name: buffer_withdrawer
docs: Cold Multisig - withdraw buffer

fields.name: cap_manager
docs: Cold Multisig - set max supply

fields.name: allowance_manager
docs: Cold Multisig - reset minter / direct-minter / direct-burner allowances

fields.name: rebaser
docs: Orchestrator - update multiplier on the OkuM mint

fields.name: usdc_mint
docs: USDC mint address

fields.name: oku_m_mint
docs: OkuM mint address (Token-2022 with ScaledUiAmount extension).
The multiplier for USDC ↔ OkuM conversion is read from the
mint's ScaledUiAmountConfig extension, not stored on PsmConfig.

fields.name: vault_usdc
docs: PSM's USDC buffer vault (ATA)

fields.name: max_supply
docs: Maximum OkuM supply cap (in raw token units)

fields.name: minter_allowance
docs: Mint allowance remaining (configurable cap on freshly minted OkuM
between admin resets, mirroring the EVM `minterAllowance` pattern).

fields.name: is_paused
docs: Whether the PSM is paused

fields.name: last_yield_distribution_slot
docs: Solana slot of the last EMERGENCY multiplier override
(`set_okum_multiplier`), for sandwich prevention. PSM operations are
blocked in the same slot.
Under streaming accrual the multiplier advances continuously, so there
is no discrete jump for a searcher to sandwich — that is the entire
point of the model. This lock therefore fires ONLY on the explicit
override path, and in particular is NOT stamped by the routine display
sync. Mirrors EVM, where `YieldSandwichGuard` keys on
`lastYieldDistributionBlock`, which only `setOkuMMultiplier` writes
(`EVM/src/token/OkuMoney.sol:107`, `EVM/src/lib/YieldSandwichGuard.sol:21-26`).

fields.name: okum_base_multiplier
docs: Multiplier snapshot taken at `okum_last_accrual_time`, WAD-scaled.
Starts at `PRECISION`. Re-snapshotted on every schedule write so
accrual is continuous across the write.

fields.name: okum_rate_per_second
docs: Active per-second rate, WAD-scaled. `PRECISION` means "no yield".

fields.name: okum_last_accrual_time
docs: Timestamp `okum_base_multiplier` was snapshotted at.

fields.name: okum_rate_end
docs: Timestamp `okum_rate_per_second` expires. `0` ONLY when halted.
Every yielding rate carries a bounded window so that an unattended
schedule HALTS (safe, recoverable, monotonic) rather than compounding
forever, and so a rate can never end at a transaction-dependent,
per-chain moment.

fields.name: okum_pending_rate_per_second
docs: Pre-staged successor rate. Activates at `okum_rate_end` with NO
transaction — which is what keeps multi-chain epoch handovers
simultaneous to the second even when the staging transactions land
days apart. `PRECISION` means "none armed".

fields.name: okum_pending_rate_end
docs: The successor's own expiry, bounding the overhang. `0` = none armed.

fields.name: last_display_sync_ts
docs: Unix timestamp of the last `sync_display_multiplier`.
Display-only bookkeeping: drives the staleness threshold for the
opportunistic piggyback sync on PSM instructions. Has no influence on
pricing — the canonical multiplier is always computed fresh.

fields.name: pending_role_admin
docs: Pending `role_admin` rotation target — the two-step admin-transfer
model (OpenZeppelin `Ownable2Step` pattern). `set_authority(RoleAdmin,
new_admin)` writes to this slot only; the rotation does NOT take
effect until `new_admin` signs `accept_role_admin`, which moves the
value into `role_admin` and clears the slot. This protects the
protocol from a typo or stale key on the proposing side silently
locking out the meta-role.
`Pubkey::default()` means "no pending rotation".

fields.name: direct_minter
docs: Operator / fiat gateway — can mint OkuM directly without USDC.
`Pubkey::default()` means "not configured / disabled".

fields.name: direct_minter_allowance
docs: Per-direct-minter allowance (separate from the USDC-backed
`minter_allowance`). Decremented on each direct mint; reset by
`allowance_manager` via `set_direct_minter_allowance`.

fields.name: direct_burner
docs: Operator / bridge backend — can burn OkuM directly without
triggering a USDC redemption.
`Pubkey::default()` means "not configured / disabled".

fields.name: direct_burner_allowance
docs: Per-direct-burner allowance. Decremented on each direct burn;
reset by `allowance_manager` via `set_direct_burner_allowance`.

types.name: RedeemEvent
docs: Emitted when OkuM is redeemed for USDC (instant redemption).
EVM equivalent: `RedeemNote(address indexed user, uint256 rawOkuMIn, uint256 usdcOut, uint256 multiplier)`

fields.name: user
docs: User who redeemed

fields.name: raw_oku_m_amount
docs: OkuM raw amount burned (6 decimals)

fields.name: usdc_amount
docs: USDC received (6 decimals)

fields.name: dollar_value
docs: Dollar value of the redeemed amount

fields.name: multiplier
docs: Canonical OkuM multiplier at time of redeem, WAD-scaled (1e18 = $1.00).
Computed from the rate schedule, NOT read from the display mirror.
EVM equivalent: multiplier

fields.name: new_total_supply
docs: OkuM supply after the burn completed.

types.name: RoleAdminTransferAcceptedEvent
docs: Emitted when `accept_role_admin` completes a previously-proposed
two-step transfer.

types.name: RoleAdminTransferCancelledEvent
docs: Emitted when `cancel_role_admin_transfer` clears an in-flight proposal.

types.name: RoleAdminTransferProposedEvent
docs: Emitted when `set_authority(RoleAdmin, ...)` proposes a two-step
transfer of the meta-role. The rotation has NOT taken effect — the new
admin must still sign `accept_role_admin` to commit it.

types.name: ThawEvent
docs: Emitted when an account is unfrozen.
EVM equivalent: `Unblacklisted(address indexed account)`

types.name: TokenMetadataUpdatedEvent
docs: Emitted when `update_token_metadata` rewrites the OkuM mint's
Token-2022 `TokenMetadata` `name`/`symbol` in place. This is the
on-chain identity shown by wallets and explorers (the true OkuM
token); the "$1-pegged usdOku" figure is a separate ScaledUiAmount
display value and is unaffected.

types.name: UnpauseEvent
docs: Emitted when PSM is unpaused.
EVM equivalent: `Unpaused(address account)`

types.name: YieldRateUpdated
docs: Emitted when the ACTIVE per-second rate or its window changes.
Replaces `YieldDistributed`. There is no longer a dollar-denominated
distribution event because there is no dollar-denominated instruction —
the operator publishes a rate, and the yield follows from it continuously.
EVM equivalent: `OkuMYieldRateUpdated`.

fields.name: old_rate
docs: Previous active per-second rate, WAD-scaled.

fields.name: new_rate
docs: New active per-second rate, WAD-scaled. `PRECISION` means halted.

fields.name: rate_end
docs: Absolute expiry of the new rate. `0` when halting.

fields.name: base_multiplier
docs: The multiplier snapshot taken at this write, so indexers can
reconstruct `m(t)` for any `t` without replaying from genesis.
